notes.title: “Monster Coming” January 12th version update
notes.content:
"Monster Coming" January 12th version update

Version number: V1.8.6

Dear warriors:

We will start updating at 10:00 on January 12, 2024. Players are asked to exit the game before this time to avoid affecting your game progress.

The content of this update is as follows:

optimization:
Modify the gold coin income in a single game

BUG:
BUG in English language skill description;

How to play:
1. Added endless mode, unlimited challenge;
2. Added a creative workshop to choose your favorite MOD through the community;


How to get the MOD toolbox:
Mail: 211206417@qq.com
Enter "MOD" to receive the MOD production toolbox

*To ensure normal updates, please close the game, verify the integrity and wait for the update download to start (find the game in the library -> right-click -> "Properties" -> "Local Files" -> "Verify the integrity of the game files" )

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/iakYF4lM] Click here to join the community discussion. We will synchronize future updates of the game here as soon as possible. In addition, we will adopt your suggestions to modify the game![/url]
